$comment: PENDING service clients for the ADS demo environment: Agriculture <-> Commerce sector integration (Agriculture wave 2, 11 Nov 2026). NOT applied by services/identity/scripts/apply-clients.mjs and not read by Identity today: they need the Identity client_credentials grant and token-exchange audience support, which is a separate Identity change. Kept apart from config/clients.demo.json so the reviewed sign-in client list, its tests and apply-clients stay unchanged until that support is merged; field names follow the planned Identity schema and are to be aligned with it on merge. No secrets here: the operator provisions each client secret on the server and stores it in the operator secrets, never in a repository.

clients.purpose: Agriculture background job reading the Commerce sector outcomes feed (client_credentials, no user, no tenant).
Commerce verifying and redeeming Agriculture input vouchers (client_credentials, no user, no tenant).

token_exchange.note: Declared on agriculture-web in config/clients.demo.json (tokenExchange). Agriculture exchanges a signed-in user's token for a Commerce token to read sector offers.
